appendSystemPrompt: Comments in this repo say why, in prose, and name what the code used to do and what went wrong with it. Multi-line ones are wanted; write them where a reason is worth keeping. Do not write the other kind, and prefer no comment to one of them: nothing restating the line below it, nothing narrating your own diff (`// now uses X instead of Y`, `// changed to`, `// added in this pass`), no banner or section header, no docstring on a proc whose name already says it. A file that gains no comment is a normal outcome. Do not create planning, summary, analysis or hand-off markdown files unless asked for one.
